visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor domestic setting. A woman with auburn hair holds the camera in a selfie position, smiling at a man in a black tank top sitting at a desk behind her. He touches his hair while she speaks. (2) Medium shot of an older bald man with glasses sitting on a grey sofa in a brightly lit living room, speaking directly to the camera with calm gestures. (3) Medium shot of an older woman in a red tank top with a patterned headband sitting on the same sofa, gesturing with her hands while speaking enthusiastically. (4) Brief cut to a young boy in a black graphic t-shirt laughing and gesturing towards something off-camera. (5) Close-up and medium shots of a young woman in a grey top eating from a bowl with a spoon in a restaurant-like setting with warm lighting. She looks at the camera and speaks. (6) Outdoor transition. The woman with auburn hair is now wearing a white cap and interviewing a young man in a dark t-shirt in front of an escalator. (7) Digital screen recording sequence. The interface transitions through the Shopee mobile app menus, specifically highlighting the 'Affiliate Program' sections, showing registration forms and video upload processes. (8) Back to the auburn-haired woman in a home studio setting. She speaks directly to the camera with high energy, pointing towards text overlays and using hand gestures to emphasize her points.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To persuade viewers to join the Shopee Affiliate Program by first establishing the universal desire for money through interviews and then demonstrating the ease of earning passive income via the app's video sharing features.
